data.note: RETRACTED (2026-05-29): the per-λ formula does NOT close the deuteron. Bare B(D) = m_e·|sum| undershoots AME by -82.9%. The Δ_λ gate remains open. See docs/audits/2026-05-18-delta-lambda-gating-context.md (CORRECTION 2026-05-29).
